findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Observed caulking to be in a state of disrepair in the following locations:
1) The kitchen hand sink caulking was observed to be coming apart. 

Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure facility is replacing caulking as needed.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.comment: Observed a stack of single service bowls to be not inverted on shelf. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and bowls were inverted. Ensure any single service item is stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11(A) Kitchenware and Tableware. (A) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of FOOD- and lip-contact surfaces is prevented.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Observed caulking to be in a state of disrepair in the following locations:
1) The kitchen hand sink caulking was observed to be coming apart. 
2) The triple sink caulking was observed to have black mold present.
3) The mop sink caulking was observed to have black mold present.

Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure facility is replacing caulking as needed.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
Observed no CFM to be on duty during inspection. Discussed with PIC. Ensure one CFM is present during all hours of operation. 

After discussion, manager on duty was able to provided proper CFM documentation. Ensure proper licensing paperwork is available in facility at all times. 

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Observed a scrub brush and 2 pads placed in the back hand washing sink. Discussed with PIC and relocated to triple sink. Ensure hand washing stations are kept accessible and are only used to wash hands. 

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
Observed a pizza spatula and pizza knife placed in between shelving and wall behind triple sink. Discussed with PIC and relocated spatula and knife. Ensure clean utensils are stored in a way that prevents contamination. 

4-904.11: (A) cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed to prevent FOOD- and lip-contact surface contamination. (B) UTENSILS not prewrapped shall be presented so only handles are touched by EMPLOYEES and/or CONSUMERS. (C) SINGLE-SERVCIE ARTICLES intended for FOOD- and lip-contact shall be furnished for CONSUMER with wrapper or APPROVED dispenser.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed an accumulation of food debris in between the prep cooler and prep table, splash residue of pizza sauce on glass barrier, and another accumulation of food debris on the prep table near the map. Discussed with PIC, ensure non food contact surface areas are cleaned at a frequency that prevents food accumulation. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the walk in cooler fan unit to be dripping from the pipe. Discussed with PIC. Ensure walk in cooler is repaired to prevent dripping. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
Observed the light in the walk in cooler to be flashing on and off. Discussed with PIC. Ensure repairs are made to allow the light to function at the manufacture’s specification. 

6-303.11: The light intensity shall be at least a certain lux and present in certain areas.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.  

(REPEAT) Observed no food handler’s licenses at the facility. Discussed with PIC. Ensure all new hires have completed food handler training within 30 days of employment. Ensure copies of the licenses are kept at the facility. License is valid for 3 years. Correct by next routine inspection.
